author: marlon-chaviano
name: saas-laravel
title: SaaS with Laravel and React
description: Laravel's official starter kit with React and Inertia: sign-up, login, email verification, account settings and a dashboard with shadcn/ui.

verify.command: npm run build && php artisan test

instructions:
## How to work here

- Routes are in `routes/web.php`; each page is a React component in `resources/js/pages/` rendered with `Inertia::render()`.
- Validate in Form Requests and authorize with Policies; the UI only hides what the server already forbids.
- UI components in `resources/js/components/ui/` (shadcn/ui).
- Before finishing: `npm run build && php artisan test`.
